name: classcore
description: 云云科（ClassCore）局域网课堂运行平台

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/prepare-dist-workspaces.mjs && node scripts/build-web-shells.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.server:smoke: npm run build && npm run server:smoke:raw
scripts.simulate:ws: npm run build && npm run simulate:ws:raw
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke:raw
scripts.check: npm run toolchain && npm run handoff:check && npm run platform:check && npm run foundation:check && npm run policy:check && npm run lockfile:check && npm run workspace:check && npm run lesson-boundary:check && npm run lesson-deletion:check && npm run docs:check && npm run quality:check && npm run validate && npm run validate:formal && npm run validate:lessons && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run template:check && npm run check:dist && npm run check:display-boundary && npm run simulate:load && npm run server:smoke:raw && npm run simulate:ws:raw && npm run smoke:raw
scripts.check:fast: npm run runtime:check && npm run handoff:check && npm run foundation:check && npm run workspace:check && npm run lesson-boundary:check && npm run lesson-deletion:check && npm run policy:check && npm run lockfile:check && npm run docs:check && npm run validate && npm run test
scripts.audit:structure: npm run handoff:check && npm run platform:check && npm run foundation:check && npm run policy:check && npm run lockfile:check && npm run workspace:check && npm run docs:check && npm run quality:check && npm run validate && npm run validate:formal && npm run validate:lessons && npm run test && npm run template:check && npm run simulate:load && npm run server:smoke:raw && npm run simulate:ws:raw && npm run smoke:raw
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run integrity:check && npm run docker:gate
scripts.prebuild: npm run runtime:check && npm run policy:check
scripts.release:d7: npm run d7:product && npm run d7:host && npm run check && npm run integrity:check && npm run docker:d7:gate
